name: install packages and OS components non-interactively
definition: Bring in git plus web/SSH server packages without an interactive confirmation inside the container.
failure_mode: Fails to install or leaves services unusable, stops the end-to-end check.

name: manipulate git history to remove or recover secrets while preserving the rest of the tracked set
definition: Rewire git objects/history to purge a leaked secret or recover one from dangling/unreachable objects without altering unrelated tracked content.
failure_mode: over-purging removes unrelated files and fails the checksum.

name: record the git commands that push and trigger the site workflow
definition: commit the changes and produce the exact push-and-run command list against a placeholder or reachable remote.
failure_mode: uncommitted state makes the delivery incomplete.

name: stand up an ssh-password-authenticated git server at a local path
definition: set up a git server reachable over ssh on a local path that accepts password authentication.
failure_mode: authentication or path configuration prevents the clone step.
